notes.title: Meetup with Urban Jungle developers
notes.content:
Cake Up & Urban Jungle


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/466ac32fd1be6ddf940aa41ce400a294fae5ff3e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/4020a3099319e7e123732b8e18720812d6502a4d.jpg"]
Today, we were invited to a meeting by our craft colleagues, the gamedev company Kylyk Games with their game Urban Jungle which became a nominee in the most cozy game category at Gamescom 2024. Urban Jungle - is a cute and meditative simulation game, where you can decorate your home and create a small blooming oasis by arranging a variety of plants.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/99359e870bf88c36141247c9ad1b8b86c1d74fa6.jpg"]Support the developers of the Urban Jungle game and also add our Cake Up game to the desired!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/b6b14d1311ee633b5666f7076473627be2ca4d9d.jpg"]
